passages.title: 穿裙子的蘇格蘭男生
passages.text: Last summer, my family traveled to Scotland. On our first day in Edinburgh, I saw a man playing music on the street. He was wearing a {1}! I was very {2}. Dad explained that it's called a kilt. In Scotland, men wear kilts at weddings, parties, and other special events. It's an important part of their history. The man's kilt was red and green, and he wore a leather {3} with it. A small bag hung from the belt in the front. He also had long white {4} that came up to his knees, and black shoes. When he finished his song, everyone clapped. My little brother asked if he could {5} one on, so Dad bought him a small kilt at a gift shop. Now my brother wears it to every family party and tells everyone, "It's not a skirt. It's a kilt!"

blanks.why: 街頭的男人穿著一件裙子 skirt，最後一句也說 It's not a skirt。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、dentist（牙醫）都不能穿。
看到男生穿裙子，我很驚訝 surprised。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、empty（空的）都不能形容人的心情。
搭配一條皮帶 belt，下一句說小包包掛在 the belt 上。bowl（碗）、soup（湯）、ticket（票）都不能掛包包、繫在身上。
長到膝蓋的白色長襪 socks。noodles（麵）、grapes（葡萄）、nurses（護士）都不能穿在腳上。
try… on「試穿」，弟弟想試穿一件。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能和 on 搭配表示穿衣服。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去蘇格蘭旅行。第一天在愛丁堡，我看到一個男人在街上演奏音樂，他竟然穿著一件裙子！我非常驚訝。爸爸解釋說那叫做「蘇格蘭裙」。在蘇格蘭，男人會在婚禮、派對和其他特別的場合穿這種裙子，這是他們歷史中很重要的一部分。那個男人的蘇格蘭裙是紅綠相間的，他還搭配了一條皮帶，皮帶前面掛著一個小包包。他也穿了長到膝蓋的白色長襪和黑皮鞋。他演奏完一首歌，大家都拍手。弟弟問能不能試穿一件，所以爸爸在紀念品店買了一件小的蘇格蘭裙給他。現在弟弟每次家庭聚會都穿它，還告訴大家：「這不是裙子，是蘇格蘭裙！」

passages.title: 雲霄飛車上飛走的球鞋
passages.text: Last weekend, my friends and I went to an amusement park. The first ride we chose was the biggest roller coaster in the park. While we were waiting in line, I felt more and more {1}. When it was our turn, a worker checked that our seat {2} were tight. Then the ride started. It went up slowly, and then it dropped very fast! I screamed so loudly that my throat hurt. In the middle of the ride, one of my friend Tina's {3} flew off her foot! When the ride stopped, she walked out in only her pink {4} on that foot. A worker found her shoe on the ground under the ride and gave it back to her. We all {5}. Next time, Tina will tie her shoelaces more tightly.

blanks.why: 排隊時越來越緊張 nervous。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容人的感覺。
seat belt「安全帶」，工作人員檢查有沒有繫緊。spoons（湯匙）、lemons（檸檬）、menus（菜單）都不能和 seat 組成座位上要繫緊的東西。
one of Tina's sneakers「Tina 的其中一隻球鞋」從腳上飛掉了，後面也說工作人員找到她的鞋。bananas（香蕉）、teeth（牙齒）、bowls（碗）都不是穿在腳上的。
鞋子掉了，那隻腳只剩粉紅色襪子 sock。cookie（餅乾）、ticket（票）、kitchen（廚房）都不能穿在腳上。
鞋子被找回來，大家都笑了 laughed。baked（烘烤）、spelled（拼字）、boiled（煮沸）都需要受詞，放在這裡不通。

passages.zh: 上週末，我和朋友去遊樂園玩。我們選的第一個設施是園區裡最大的雲霄飛車。排隊的時候，我越來越緊張。輪到我們時，一位工作人員檢查我們的安全帶有沒有繫緊。接著列車出發了，它慢慢往上爬，然後突然高速往下衝！我叫得太大聲，喉嚨都痛了。坐到一半，我朋友 Tina 的一隻球鞋竟然從腳上飛了出去！列車停下來後，她那隻腳只穿著粉紅色的襪子走出來。一位工作人員在設施下方的地上找到她的鞋子，還給了她。我們全都笑了出來。下次 Tina 一定會把鞋帶綁得更緊。

passages.title: 聖誕襪裡的禮物
passages.text: In many Western countries, children hang big red {1} by the fireplace on Christmas Eve. They hope Santa Claus will fill them with gifts. When I was little, my mom told me about this, so I hung one of my school socks on my bed. I {2} Santa would find it. The next morning, I was so excited. Inside the sock, there was a chocolate, a small toy car, and a pair of warm {3}. I didn't know it was Mom until I was ten. Now I am fifteen, and I do the same thing for my little sister. This year, I'm going to put in a cute hair clip, some candy, and a tiny pink {4} for her favorite doll. I want her to {5} in Santa for a few more years.

blanks.why: 平安夜在壁爐旁掛大紅襪子 socks，下一句也說用學校的襪子。lemons（檸檬）、spoons（湯匙）、dentists（牙醫）都不能裝禮物掛起來。
我希望 hoped 聖誕老公公會找到它。baked（烘烤）、spelled（拼字）、boiled（煮沸）都不能接一個句子表示心裡的期待。
a pair of warm gloves「一雙保暖的手套」。noodles（麵）、soups（湯）、menus（菜單）都不能用 a pair of 和 warm 來說。
給妹妹最喜歡的娃娃一件粉紅色小裙子 skirt。tooth（牙齒）、plate（盤子）、knife（刀子）都不適合當送娃娃的衣服。
believe in Santa「相信有聖誕老公公」。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 in Santa。

passages.zh: 在很多西方國家，小朋友會在平安夜把大大的紅襪子掛在壁爐旁邊，希望聖誕老公公在裡面裝滿禮物。我小時候，媽媽告訴我這件事，所以我把一隻學校的襪子掛在床邊，希望聖誕老公公能找到它。隔天早上，我好興奮，襪子裡有一顆巧克力、一台玩具小汽車，還有一雙保暖手套。直到十歲我才知道那是媽媽放的。現在我十五歲了，我也幫妹妹做一樣的事。今年，我打算放一個可愛的髮夾、一些糖果，還有一件給她最愛的娃娃穿的粉紅色小裙子。我希望她能再多相信聖誕老公公幾年。

passages.title: 守門員的新手套
passages.text: I'm the goalkeeper of our school soccer team. A goalkeeper's most important tool is a good pair of {1}. They protect your hands and help you catch the ball. Last month, my old gloves got a big hole, so I saved my pocket money to buy new ones. Before our big game against Sunrise Junior High, I put on my lucky blue {2} and my new gloves. My coach told me to {3} calm. In the last minute, the other team got a penalty kick. Everyone was watching me. Their best player ran and kicked the ball hard to the left. I jumped and {4} it! My teammates ran over and hugged me. After the game, I found that my new gloves were covered in mud, and my white {5} were brown. But I didn't care. We won!

blanks.why: 守門員最重要的工具是一雙好手套 gloves，可以保護手、幫忙接球。noodles（麵）、lemons（檸檬）、dentists（牙醫）都不是守門員的工具。
穿上我的幸運藍襪子 socks 和新手套。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能 put on。
stay calm「保持冷靜」。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 calm。
我跳起來接住 caught 球。boiled（煮沸）、prayed（祈禱）、spelled（拼字）都不能表示接球。
白色球鞋 sneakers 沾滿泥巴變成棕色。bananas（香蕉）、plates（盤子）、candies（糖果）都不是踢球時穿的。

passages.zh: 我是學校足球隊的守門員。守門員最重要的工具就是一雙好手套，它能保護你的手，也能幫你接住球。上個月，我的舊手套破了一個大洞，所以我存零用錢買了一雙新的。在對上日昇國中的大賽前，我穿上我的幸運藍襪子，戴上新手套。教練叫我保持冷靜。比賽最後一分鐘，對方得到一個罰球機會，大家都盯著我。他們最厲害的球員助跑後，用力把球往左邊踢。我飛身一跳，接住了！隊友們跑過來抱住我。比賽結束後，我發現新手套沾滿了泥巴，白色球鞋也變成棕色了。但我一點也不在乎，我們贏了！

passages.title: 表哥的跆拳道黑帶
passages.text: My cousin Jason started learning taekwondo when he was six. At first, he wore a white {1}, like all beginners. Every year, he took a test, and if he passed, he got a belt of a new color. He {2} hard three times a week, even when he was tired. Last Saturday, he took the test for his black belt. He had to kick, punch, and break a wooden board with his hand. Nobody wears shoes or {3} in taekwondo, so he did everything in bare feet. When the teacher tied the black {4} around his waist, Jason's mom cried. Jason said to his parents, "Thank you for always coming to watch me." His little brother was so excited that he wants to {5} the class next year.

blanks.why: 初學者都繫白帶 belt，後面也說 a belt of a new color。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、bowl（碗）都不能「繫在身上」代表等級。
他一星期苦練 practiced 三次。baked（烘烤）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）都不能和 hard three times a week 一起說練功。
跆拳道不穿鞋也不穿襪子 socks，所以赤腳。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿在腳上。
老師把黑帶 belt 綁在他腰上。lemon（檸檬）、ticket（票）、plate（盤子）都不能綁在腰上。
join the class「參加課程」，弟弟明年也想學。boil（煮沸）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 the class。

passages.zh: 我表哥 Jason 六歲開始學跆拳道。一開始，他和所有初學者一樣繫白帶。每年他都要參加考試，通過了就能換一條新顏色的帶子。他一星期苦練三次，就算很累也一樣。上星期六，他參加了黑帶考試，要踢腿、出拳，還要用手劈斷一塊木板。練跆拳道不穿鞋也不穿襪子，所以他全程都打赤腳。當老師把黑帶綁在他腰上時，Jason 的媽媽哭了。Jason 對爸媽說：「謝謝你們一直來看我練習。」他弟弟興奮到明年也想去上課。

passages.title: 年夜飯後的皮帶
passages.text: Every Chinese New Year, my family eats a huge dinner at Grandma's house. She cooks chicken, fish, pork, dumplings, and lots of vegetables. This year, Dad ate three bowls of rice and lots of meat. After dinner, he sat on the sofa and said, "I'm so {1} that I can't move." Then he quietly loosened his {2} a little. Everyone saw it and laughed. Then Grandma {3} out dessert, and Dad still ate two pieces of cake! Later, we all went outside to watch fireworks. It was cold, so I wore my wool {4} and a long {5} with thick tights. Dad tried to tie his shoes, but his stomach was too big for him to bend down. In the end, my little brother had to help him.

blanks.why: 吃太多，飽 full 到動不了。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careless（粗心的）都和吃太飽無關。
吃太飽，偷偷把皮帶 belt 鬆開一點。lemon（檸檬）、spoon（湯匙）、menu（菜單）都不能 loosen（鬆開）。
bring out dessert「端出甜點」。boiled（煮沸）、spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）都不能和 out dessert 搭配。
天冷，戴上羊毛手套 gloves。grapes（葡萄）、soups（湯）、knives（刀子）都不能穿戴。
穿一件長裙 skirt 配厚褲襪。tooth（牙齒）、bowl（碗）、ticket（票）都不能穿。

passages.zh: 每年過年，我們全家都在奶奶家吃一頓豐盛的年夜飯。她會煮雞、魚、豬肉、水餃和很多蔬菜。今年爸爸吃了三碗飯和一大堆肉。吃完飯，他坐在沙發上說：「我飽到動不了了。」接著他偷偷把皮帶鬆開一點，大家看到都笑了。然後奶奶端出甜點，爸爸竟然還吃了兩塊蛋糕！後來，我們全都到外面看煙火。天氣很冷，所以我戴上羊毛手套，穿了一件長裙配厚褲襪。爸爸想綁鞋帶，可是肚子太大，彎不下腰，最後只好讓弟弟幫他綁。

passages.title: 襪子布偶劇
passages.text: Our English teacher, Ms. Wu, gave us a fun project. Each group had to make sock puppets and act out a short story in English. My group decided to do "The Three Little Pigs." First, we {1} old socks from home. We used pink socks for the pigs and a gray one for the wolf. Then we added button eyes and paper ears. My friend Ben cut a tiny {2} out of cloth for the third pig, because we decided she was a girl. He also made a little {3} for the wolf to make him look cool. On the day of the show, we hid behind a table and held up our puppets. When the wolf said, "I'll blow your house down," the whole class {4} because Ben's voice was so funny. We got the highest score in the class. Now I never throw away old {5}!

blanks.why: 從家裡收集 collected 舊襪子來做布偶。baked（烘烤）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）都不能接 old socks。
用布剪一件小裙子 skirt 給第三隻小豬，因為她是女生。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、bowl（碗）都不能用布剪出來當衣服。
給大野狼做一條小皮帶 belt 讓牠看起來很酷。noodle（麵）、tooth（牙齒）、menu（菜單）都不是布偶的服裝配件。
Ben 的聲音太好笑，全班都笑了 laughed。boiled（煮沸）、spelled（拼字）、prayed（祈禱）都不能表示看表演的反應。
現在我再也不丟舊襪子 socks 了，因為可以做布偶。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、knives（刀子）都和這個活動無關。

passages.zh: 我們的英文老師吳老師給了我們一個有趣的作業：每一組要做襪子布偶，用英文演一個短短的故事。我們這組決定演《三隻小豬》。首先，我們從家裡收集舊襪子，用粉紅色的襪子做小豬，用一隻灰色的做大野狼。接著我們加上鈕扣眼睛和紙耳朵。我朋友 Ben 用布剪了一件小裙子給第三隻小豬，因為我們決定她是女生。他還幫大野狼做了一條小皮帶，讓牠看起來很酷。表演那天，我們躲在桌子後面舉起布偶。當大野狼說「我要把你的房子吹倒」時，全班都笑翻了，因為 Ben 的聲音太好笑了。我們拿到全班最高分。現在我再也不丟舊襪子了！

passages.title: 公車上的一隻手套
passages.text: One cold morning, I took the bus to school. A little girl and her grandma sat next to me. When they got off, I saw a small pink {1} on the seat. It had a white rabbit on it. I wanted to give it back, but the bus had already {2} the stop. So I took the glove to school with me. The next morning, I saw them again at the same bus stop. The little girl was wearing only one glove, and her other hand was red from the cold. I gave her the pink glove, and her face lit up. "Thank you! My grandma made these for me," she said. Her grandma was {3} too. She gave me a pair of warm wool {4} that she knitted herself. Now I wear them every day with my {5}.

blanks.why: 座位上有一隻粉紅色小手套 glove，後面也說小女孩只戴一隻 glove。lemon（檸檬）、spoon（湯匙）、bowl（碗）都和後文不合。
公車已經離開 left 站牌了，所以來不及還。boiled（煮沸）、prayed（祈禱）、spelled（拼字）都不能接 the stop。
奶奶也很高興 glad。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、salty（鹹的）都不能形容人的心情。
奶奶送我一雙她自己織的羊毛襪 socks。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能用毛線織。
每天把襪子配球鞋 sneakers 穿。noodles（麵）、plates（盤子）、throats（喉嚨）都不能和襪子一起穿。

passages.zh: 一個寒冷的早上，我搭公車上學。一個小女孩和她奶奶坐在我旁邊。她們下車後，我看到座位上有一隻粉紅色小手套，上面有一隻白兔。我想還給她，但公車已經開走了，所以我只好把手套帶去學校。隔天早上，我又在同一個公車站遇到她們。小女孩只戴著一隻手套，另一隻手凍得紅紅的。我把粉紅手套還給她，她的臉一下子亮了起來。「謝謝你！這是我奶奶幫我做的。」她說。她奶奶也很高興，送了我一雙她親手織的羊毛襪。現在我每天都把它們配球鞋穿。

passages.title: 陽明山的泥巴球鞋
passages.text: Last Saturday, our scout group went hiking on Yangmingshan. The leader told us to wear old {1} because the trail could be muddy. I didn't listen. I wore my new white ones. It rained the night before, so the trail was very wet. After ten minutes, my shoes were covered in mud. Then I stepped into a deep puddle, and my {2} got completely wet. My feet felt cold and heavy. My friend Leo was smarter. He wore rain boots, and he also brought a pair of {3} to hold the ropes on the steep parts. When we reached the top, the sky {4} up, and we could see all of Taipei. It was beautiful. At home, Mom washed my sneakers for an hour. Next time, I will {5} the leader's advice.

blanks.why: 領隊叫大家穿舊球鞋 sneakers，因為步道可能很泥濘。lemons（檸檬）、spoons（湯匙）、dentists（牙醫）都不能穿去爬山。
踩進水坑，襪子 socks 全濕了。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不是腳上穿的。
帶一雙手套 gloves 抓陡坡的繩子。noodles（麵）、knives（刀子）、plates（盤子）都不能用 a pair of 來說，也不能保護手。
clear up「放晴」，到山頂時天空放晴。baked（烘烤）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）都不能說天氣。
follow advice「聽從建議」。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 advice。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們童軍團去陽明山健行。領隊叫我們穿舊球鞋，因為步道可能很泥濘。我沒聽，穿了我的新白鞋。前一晚下過雨，步道非常濕。走了十分鐘，我的鞋子就沾滿泥巴。後來我又一腳踩進一個深水坑，襪子全濕了，腳又冷又重。我朋友 Leo 比較聰明，他穿了雨靴，還帶了一雙手套，在陡坡的地方抓繩子。我們到達山頂時，天空放晴了，可以看見整個台北，景色好美。回家後，媽媽幫我洗球鞋洗了一個小時。下次我一定會聽領隊的建議。

passages.title: 奶奶的百褶裙
passages.text: My grandma loves to dance. Every morning, she dances with her friends in the park near our home. Last month, their group joined a dance contest for old people. Grandma wanted to look her best, so she took out an old blue pleated {1} from her closet. She wore it when she was young! It still fit her well. She also bought new white {2} and a pair of soft dance {3}. For a week, she practiced every day. On the day of the contest, I went to {4} for her. When the music started, her skirt moved like a flower. Grandma and her friends danced so well that they won second prize. She was so {5} of herself. With a big smile, she said, "Age is just a number!"

blanks.why: 從衣櫥拿出一件藍色舊百褶裙 skirt，後面也說 her skirt moved like a flower。lemon（檸檬）、spoon（湯匙）、bowl（碗）都不會放在衣櫥裡穿。
買了新的白襪子 socks。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿。
a pair of soft dance sneakers「一雙軟的跳舞運動鞋」。noodles（麵）、knives（刀子）、throats（喉嚨）都不能穿去跳舞。
cheer for…「為…加油」。bake（烘烤）、spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）都不能接 for her 表示加油。
be proud of oneself「為自己感到驕傲」。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、salty（鹹的）都不能接 of herself。

passages.zh: 我奶奶很愛跳舞，每天早上都和朋友在我家附近的公園跳舞。上個月，她們這組參加了一場銀髮族舞蹈比賽。奶奶想以最好的樣子出場，於是從衣櫥拿出一件藍色的舊百褶裙，那是她年輕時穿的！現在穿起來還是很合身。她還買了新的白襪子和一雙軟軟的跳舞運動鞋。整整一個星期，她每天都在練習。比賽那天，我去幫她加油。音樂一響起，她的裙子就像花朵一樣飄動。奶奶和她的朋友跳得太好了，拿到第二名。她非常以自己為傲，笑得很開心地說：「年齡只是一個數字！」

passages.title: 拳擊館的第一堂課
passages.text: Last month, my dad took me to a boxing gym for my first class. The coach, a tall woman named Sara, gave me a pair of red boxing {1}. They were big and heavy, and my hands looked like giant tomatoes. First, she taught me how to stand. "Keep your feet apart and your hands up near your face," she said. Then I {2} hitting a big bag. After ten minutes, my arms were so tired! I was wearing shorts, a T-shirt, and old {3}, and I was sweating a lot. At the end of the class, the coach showed us her gold champion {4} from a big contest. I was so {5} that I wanted to learn more. When I took off my gloves, my hands smelled terrible. My dad laughed and said, "That's how you know you worked hard."

blanks.why: a pair of boxing gloves「一雙拳擊手套」，後面也說 took off my gloves。noodles（麵）、lemons（檸檬）、dentists（牙醫）都不能戴在手上打拳。
practice + V-ing「練習做…」，練習打沙包。baked（烘烤）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）都不能接 hitting。
穿短褲、T 恤和舊球鞋 sneakers 上課。bananas（香蕉）、plates（盤子）、candies（糖果）都不能穿。
champion belt「冠軍腰帶」，拳擊比賽贏了會得到。spoon（湯匙）、bowl（碗）、ticket（票）都不能和 gold champion 一起說比賽得到的腰帶。
興奮 excited 到想學更多。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、empty（空的）都不能形容人的心情。

passages.zh: 上個月，爸爸帶我去拳擊館上第一堂課。教練是一位叫 Sara 的高個子女生，她給我一雙紅色拳擊手套，又大又重，我的手看起來像兩顆巨大的番茄。首先，她教我怎麼站。「兩腳分開，雙手舉高靠近臉。」她說。接著我練習打一個大沙包，十分鐘後手臂就好痠！我穿著短褲、T 恤和舊球鞋，流了好多汗。下課前，教練給我們看她在一場大比賽中贏得的金色冠軍腰帶。我興奮到很想學更多。我脫下手套時，手的味道超可怕。爸爸笑著說：「這就代表你很努力了。」

passages.title: 不穿襪子的下場
passages.text: My brother Max hates wearing {1}. He says they make his feet feel hot. So every day, he puts his bare feet right into his {2} and goes to school. Mom warned him many times, but he never listened. Then one evening, our family went to a Japanese restaurant. Everyone had to take off their shoes at the door. When Max took off his, a terrible smell {3} the room. The people at the next table looked at us. The waiter even opened a window! Max's face turned as red as a tomato. On the way home, he was very quiet. The next morning, he asked Mom to buy him ten pairs of socks. He also put on a pair of plastic {4} and washed his shoes himself. Since then, he has never {5} to wear socks.

blanks.why: 討厭穿襪子 socks，說會讓腳很熱。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿在腳上。
光著腳直接穿進球鞋 sneakers 裡。lemons（檸檬）、spoons（湯匙）、dentists（牙醫）都不能把腳放進去穿。
一股可怕的臭味充滿 filled 整個房間。baked（烘烤）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）都不能說氣味。
戴上一雙塑膠手套 gloves 自己洗鞋子。noodles（麵）、knives（刀子）、plates（盤子）都不能 put on 戴在手上。
has never forgotten to…「從來沒有忘記…」。boiled（煮沸）、prayed（祈禱）、spelled（拼字）都不能接 to wear socks。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Max 很討厭穿襪子，他說襪子讓他的腳很熱。所以他每天都光著腳直接穿球鞋去上學。媽媽警告過他很多次，但他從來不聽。後來有一天晚上，我們全家去一家日本料理店，每個人都要在門口脫鞋。Max 一脫下鞋子，一股可怕的臭味就充滿了整個房間。隔壁桌的人都看著我們，服務生甚至打開了窗戶！Max 的臉紅得像番茄一樣。回家路上，他一句話也沒說。隔天早上，他請媽媽幫他買十雙襪子，還戴上塑膠手套自己洗鞋子。從那以後，他再也沒有忘記穿襪子。

passages.title: 太空人的手套
passages.text: Have you ever wondered what astronauts wear in space? Last week, our science teacher showed us a video about space suits. A space suit is like a small spaceship. It keeps the astronaut warm and gives them air. The {1} are the hardest part to make. They must be thick enough to protect the hands, but thin enough for the fingers to move. In the video, an astronaut was fixing something outside the space station. She wore a special {2} with many tools on it, so nothing would float away. Under the space suit, astronauts also wear special underwear and {3} to stay warm. After the video, our teacher gave us thick ski gloves and asked us to {4} to pick up a coin. It was so {5}! I couldn't do it. Now I know how hard an astronaut's job is.

blanks.why: 手套 gloves 最難做，要厚到保護手、又要薄到手指能動。lemons（檸檬）、soups（湯）、dentists（牙醫）都不是太空衣的一部分。
腰上繫一條掛滿工具的特殊腰帶 belt，東西才不會飄走。spoon（湯匙）、bowl（碗）、ticket（票）都不能掛工具繫在身上。
太空衣裡面還穿特殊內衣和襪子 socks 保暖。grapes（葡萄）、noodles（麵）、menus（菜單）都不能穿。
try to…「試著…」，試著撿起一枚硬幣。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 to pick up a coin。
戴厚手套撿硬幣很困難 difficult，我做不到。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容一件事難不難。

passages.zh: 你有沒有想過太空人在太空中穿什麼？上星期，自然老師給我們看了一段關於太空衣的影片。太空衣就像一艘小太空船，能讓太空人保持溫暖，還提供空氣。手套是最難做的部分，它要厚到能保護雙手，又要薄到手指可以活動。影片中，一位太空人正在太空站外面修東西。她繫著一條掛滿工具的特殊腰帶，這樣東西才不會飄走。太空衣裡面，太空人還會穿特殊的內衣和襪子來保暖。看完影片，老師發給我們厚厚的滑雪手套，要我們試著撿起一枚硬幣。真的好難！我根本做不到。現在我知道太空人的工作有多辛苦了。

passages.title: 第一次去溜冰場
passages.text: Last Sunday, my friends and I went ice skating for the first time. Before we got on the ice, a worker told us to wear thick {1}, because the skates could hurt our feet. She also told us to wear {2}. "If you fall, the ice can cut your hands," she said. My friend Lily was wearing a short {3}, and her legs got really cold. I wore jeans, so I was fine. At first, we held on to the wall and moved very slowly. Then a small boy skated past us like a bird. We couldn't {4} how fast he was. I fell down ten times, but I didn't give up. By the end of the day, I could skate a whole lap without falling. It was cold, but it was the most {5} day of my winter vacation.

blanks.why: 穿厚襪子 socks，冰鞋才不會磨腳。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿在腳上。
戴手套 gloves，跌倒時冰才不會割傷手。lemons（檸檬）、knives（刀子）、plates（盤子）都不能保護手。
Lily 穿短裙 skirt，腿很冷。spoon（湯匙）、tooth（牙齒）、bowl（碗）都不能穿。
couldn't believe how fast he was「不敢相信他有多快」。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 how fast he was。
the most fun day「最好玩的一天」。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、empty（空的）都不能形容這一天的心情。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我和朋友第一次去溜冰。上冰之前，一位工作人員叫我們穿厚襪子，因為冰鞋可能會磨傷腳。她還叫我們戴手套。「如果跌倒，冰會割傷你們的手。」她說。我朋友 Lily 穿了一件短裙，腿冷得要命；我穿牛仔褲，所以還好。一開始，我們抓著牆壁慢慢移動。接著，一個小男孩像小鳥一樣從我們身邊滑過去，我們簡直不敢相信他有多快。我跌倒了十次，但我沒有放棄。到了最後，我已經能不跌倒地滑完一整圈。雖然很冷，但那是我寒假最好玩的一天。

passages.title: 女生也可以穿褲子
passages.text: At my school, girls used to have to wear a {1} with their uniform every day. Many girls didn't like it, especially in winter. "My legs are freezing!" my classmate Ivy often said. Also, it was hard to play basketball or run in a skirt. So last year, the student council asked the principal to {2} the rule. After many meetings, the principal finally agreed. Now girls can choose to wear a skirt or long pants. On cold days, most girls wear pants with warm {3}. In summer, some still wear skirts because they are cooler. Ivy now wears pants and {4} every day, and she plays basketball at every break. "I feel so {5}!" she said. I think it's great that students can choose for themselves.

blanks.why: 以前女生每天都得穿裙子 skirt 配制服，後面也說 in a skirt。lemon（檸檬）、spoon（湯匙）、bowl（碗）都不能穿。
請校長修改 change 規定。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 the rule。
冷天穿長褲配保暖襪子 socks。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿。
穿長褲和球鞋 sneakers，下課去打籃球。noodles（麵）、knives（刀子）、throats（喉嚨）都不能穿。
可以自由選擇，覺得好自由 free。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、empty（空的）都不能表達這種心情。

passages.zh: 在我們學校，以前女生每天都得穿裙子配制服。很多女生不喜歡，尤其是冬天。「我的腿快凍僵了！」我同學 Ivy 常這麼說。而且穿裙子很難打籃球或跑步。所以去年，學生會請校長修改這條規定。開了很多次會之後，校長終於同意了。現在女生可以選擇穿裙子或長褲。冷天時，大部分女生都穿長褲配保暖的襪子；夏天有些人還是穿裙子，因為比較涼。Ivy 現在每天都穿長褲和球鞋，每節下課都去打籃球。「我覺得好自由！」她說。我覺得學生能自己做選擇真的很棒。

passages.title: 愛偷襪子的柴犬
passages.text: Our dog, Mochi, is a cute Shiba Inu, but he has a bad habit. He loves to steal {1}! Every morning, he goes into our bedrooms and takes one from the floor. Then he {2} it under the sofa. Last week, Dad couldn't find his work socks, so he went to work in one black sock and one white one. His boss noticed and laughed. Mochi doesn't only steal socks. Once, he took Mom's leather {3} and chewed it. Another time, he ran away with my winter {4} and buried it in the garden. Finally, we moved the sofa and found a big pile of socks, two hair ties, and a toy! Mom washed everything. Now we always {5} to put our clothes in the basket before bed.

blanks.why: 牠愛偷襪子 socks，後面也說找到一大堆襪子。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都和後文不合。
把襪子藏 hides 在沙發底下。bakes（烘烤）、spells（拼字）、marries（結婚）都不能接 under the sofa。
媽媽的皮帶 belt 被咬了。lemon（檸檬）、tooth（牙齒）、bowl（碗）都不能說 leather（皮製的）衣物配件。
叼走我冬天的手套 glove 埋在花園。spoon（湯匙）、knife（刀子）、plate（盤子）都不能用 winter 形容，也不是衣物。
remember to…「記得去做…」，睡前記得把衣服放進籃子。boil（煮沸）、pray（祈禱）、spell（拼字）都不能這樣用。

passages.zh: 我們家的狗 Mochi 是一隻可愛的柴犬，但牠有個壞習慣：牠超愛偷襪子！每天早上，牠都會跑進我們的房間，從地上叼走一隻，然後藏到沙發底下。上星期，爸爸找不到他上班穿的襪子，只好一腳穿黑襪、一腳穿白襪去上班，結果被老闆發現笑了一頓。Mochi 不只偷襪子。有一次，牠叼走媽媽的皮帶咬得亂七八糟；還有一次，牠叼著我的冬季手套跑掉，把它埋在花園裡。最後，我們把沙發移開，發現一大堆襪子、兩條髮圈和一個玩具！媽媽把東西全部洗乾淨。現在我們睡前都會記得把衣服放進籃子裡。

passages.title: 穿球鞋的灰姑娘
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Ella. She lived with her mean stepmother and two stepsisters. One day, the prince held a big party. Ella wanted to go, but she had nothing to wear. Suddenly, a fairy appeared. With her magic, Ella got a beautiful long {1} and a shining gold {2}. "What about shoes?" the fairy asked. "Glass shoes are too {3}," Ella said. "Can I have some comfortable {4} instead?" At the party, Ella danced with the prince all night. At midnight, she had to run home. She ran so fast that the prince couldn't catch her. She didn't lose her shoe, but she dropped one white {5}. The next day, the prince visited every house in the town with the sock. When it fit Ella's foot, he smiled and said, "I found you!"

blanks.why: 仙女變出一件美麗的長裙 skirt。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、bowl（碗）都不是參加舞會穿的。
搭配一條閃亮的金色腰帶 belt。soup（湯）、tooth（牙齒）、ticket（票）都不是服裝配件。
玻璃鞋太危險 dangerous 了，可能會破。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能說明她不要玻璃鞋的原因。
換成舒服的球鞋 sneakers，所以跑得很快。noodles（麵）、knives（刀子）、throats（喉嚨）都不能穿在腳上。
她掉了一隻白襪子 sock，王子拿著 the sock 找人。cookie（餅乾）、plate（盤子）、kitchen（廚房）都不能「套在腳上試」。

passages.zh: 從前從前，有一個叫 Ella 的女孩，她和刻薄的繼母以及兩個繼姊住在一起。有一天，王子舉辦了一場盛大的舞會。Ella 很想去，但她沒有衣服可以穿。突然，一位仙女出現了。仙女施展魔法，讓 Ella 穿上一件美麗的長裙，還繫上一條閃亮的金色腰帶。「那鞋子呢？」仙女問。「玻璃鞋太危險了，」Ella 說，「可以給我一雙舒服的球鞋嗎？」在舞會上，Ella 和王子跳了一整晚的舞。到了午夜，她得跑回家。她跑得飛快，王子根本追不上。她沒有掉鞋子，卻掉了一隻白襪子。第二天，王子拿著那隻襪子走遍鎮上每一戶人家。當襪子剛好套進 Ella 的腳時，他笑著說：「我找到你了！」

passages.title: 安全帶救了我們
passages.text: Every time we get in the car, my dad says, "Seat {1} on, everyone!" I used to think he was too careful. But last winter, something happened that changed my mind. We were driving to my grandma's house on a rainy night. Suddenly, a scooter came out of a small road. Dad stopped the car very {2}, and the car slid on the wet road and hit a tree. My body went forward, but my seat belt held me in my seat. Nobody was hurt, and the scooter rider was fine too. When I got out of the car, I saw that I had lost one of my {3}. I stood on the cold, wet road in only my {4}. A police officer said, "You're lucky you were all wearing seat belts." Since that night, I always {5} that everyone's belt is on before Dad starts the car.

blanks.why: seat belts on「繫上安全帶」，後文也說 my seat belt held me。spoons（湯匙）、lemons（檸檬）、menus（菜單）都不能和 seat 組成安全裝置。
機車突然衝出來，爸爸很快地 quickly 停車。proudly（驕傲地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容緊急煞車。
下車才發現掉了一隻球鞋 sneakers，所以只穿襪子站著。bananas（香蕉）、teeth（牙齒）、bowls（碗）都不是穿在腳上的。
鞋子掉了，只穿著襪子 socks 站在濕冷的路上。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿。
check that…「確認…」，確認大家都繫好安全帶。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 每次上車，爸爸都會說：「大家把安全帶繫好！」我以前覺得他太小心了。但去年冬天發生的一件事，讓我改變了想法。那是一個下雨的晚上，我們開車要去奶奶家。突然，一台機車從一條小路衝出來。爸爸很快地踩下煞車，車子在濕滑的路面上滑出去，撞到一棵樹。我的身體往前衝，但安全帶把我牢牢固定在座位上。沒有人受傷，機車騎士也沒事。下車後，我發現我掉了一隻球鞋，只穿著襪子站在又冷又濕的路上。一位警察說：「還好你們都有繫安全帶。」從那天晚上起，爸爸發動車子前，我都會確認大家都繫好安全帶。

passages.title: 環日月潭騎單車
passages.text: Sun Moon Lake is one of the most beautiful places in Taiwan. Last spring, my family rode bikes around the lake. Before we started, Dad gave each of us a pair of bike {1}. "They'll protect your hands if you fall," he said. I wore shorts, a T-shirt, and my running {2}. My sister wore a long {3}, and it almost got caught in the bike chain! So she tied it into a knot. The road went up and down along the lake, and the view was {4}. We stopped many times to take photos and eat ice cream. After four hours, we finished the whole 30-kilometer ride. My legs were tired, and my {5} were wet with sweat, but I felt great.

blanks.why: a pair of bike gloves「一雙騎車手套」，跌倒時能保護手。noodles（麵）、lemons（檸檬）、dentists（牙醫）都不能保護手。
穿短褲、T 恤和跑步球鞋 sneakers。bananas（香蕉）、plates（盤子）、candies（糖果）都不能穿。
姊姊穿長裙 skirt，差點捲進鏈條。spoon（湯匙）、tooth（牙齒）、bowl（碗）都不能穿，也不會被捲進鏈條。
湖邊的景色很棒 wonderful。wooden（木製的）、salty（鹹的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容景色。
騎完四小時，襪子 socks 被汗浸濕了。soups（湯）、grapes（葡萄）、menus（菜單）都不能穿。

passages.zh: 日月潭是台灣最美的地方之一。去年春天，我們全家騎腳踏車環湖。出發前，爸爸發給我們每人一雙騎車手套。「如果跌倒，手套可以保護你們的手。」他說。我穿了短褲、T 恤和跑步用的球鞋。姊姊穿了一件長裙，差點捲進腳踏車的鏈條裡！所以她把裙子打了一個結。道路沿著湖邊上上下下，景色美極了。我們停下來好多次拍照、吃冰淇淋。騎了四個小時，我們終於完成三十公里的路程。我的腿好痠，襪子也被汗浸濕了，但我覺得棒極了。

passages.title: 叔叔的工具腰帶
passages.text: My uncle Leo can fix anything. He's a builder, and he always wears a brown tool {1} around his waist. It has many pockets for his hammer and screwdrivers. Last weekend, he came to {2} the broken door in our kitchen. I helped him. First, he gave me a pair of work {3} to protect my hands. They were too big for me, but I didn't mind. Then he showed me how to use a screwdriver. It was harder than it looked! While we were working, I stepped on a nail. Luckily, my thick {4} protected my foot. After two hours, the door was as good as new. Uncle Leo said I was a great helper and {5} me a small hammer of my own.

blanks.why: tool belt「工具腰帶」，繫在腰上、有很多口袋。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、bowl（碗）都不能繫在腰上放工具。
來修理 fix 壞掉的門。bake（烘烤）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 the broken door。
a pair of work gloves「一雙工作手套」，保護雙手。noodles（麵）、soups（湯）、menus（菜單）都不能戴在手上。
厚球鞋 sneakers 保護了我的腳，沒被釘子刺傷。bananas（香蕉）、plates（盤子）、candies（糖果）都不是穿在腳上的。
give + 人 + 東西「給某人某物」，送我一把小鐵鎚。boiled（煮沸）、prayed（祈禱）、spelled（拼字）都不能接兩個受詞。

passages.zh: 我的叔叔 Leo 什麼都會修。他是建築工人，腰上總是繫著一條棕色的工具腰帶，上面有很多口袋可以放鐵鎚和螺絲起子。上週末，他來幫我們修廚房壞掉的門，我在旁邊幫忙。首先，他給我一雙工作手套保護雙手，雖然對我來說太大了，但我不介意。接著他教我怎麼用螺絲起子，比看起來難多了！工作的時候，我踩到一根釘子，幸好我的厚球鞋保護了我的腳。兩個小時後，門修得跟新的一樣。Leo 叔叔說我是很棒的小幫手，還送我一把我自己的小鐵鎚。
